use_cases.name: Initialize documentation project
use_cases.actor_intent: Подключить engine к существующей документации без требования структурировать все Markdown.
acceptance: Plain Markdown остаётся usable без JSON migration.
Runtime directories создаются только внутри configured documentation root/project state paths.
Повторный init идемпотентен или явно сообщает конфликт.

use_cases.name: Register managed resource
use_cases.actor_intent: Добавить structured resource с canonical data и materialization metadata.
use_cases.cli_surface: Author managed JSON under docs/_structured; inspect/discover via `docengine resources`.
acceptance: Resource проходит schema validation.
Materialization target определён в $docengine metadata.
Регистрация не создаёт dependency logic в JSON.

use_cases.name: Define dependency semantics
use_cases.actor_intent: Определить project-code dependency semantics: deterministic source edges фиксируются по фактическим tracked reads, semantic dependencies задаются explicit rules.
preconditions: target/source addressable or file path valid
inputs: deterministic builder code and/or semantic dependency rule
reads: deterministic inputs through BuildContext at build time
side_effects: future deterministic builds capture actual tracked reads; semantic rules provide explicit review dependencies
use_cases.cli_surface: Project code API/registry only. Deterministic source edges are discovered from ctx.read()/ctx.get() during builds; semantic review sources are declared explicitly in project rules.
acceptance: Dependency semantics находится в project code, не canonical resource data.
Deterministic source edges не поддерживаются вручную: receipt captures actual ctx.read()/ctx.get() reads.
Semantic dependency rules explicitly declare source refs/comparators and remain external to canonical resource data.
Registered/executed dependencies can be inspected by graph/explain.

use_cases.name: Load structured objects
use_cases.actor_intent: Загрузить managed structured resources как validated typed/raw objects.
acceptance: Stored fields map automatically without manual per-field assignment.
Raw object does not gain derived fields.
Loading does not mutate source files.

use_cases.name: Build derived object
use_cases.actor_intent: Построить новый derived object из raw/derived inputs обычным project code.
use_cases.cli_surface: Builder API; runtime execution via `docengine rebuild TARGET`.
acceptance: Raw inputs remain unchanged.
Derived object is a new immutable in-memory value.
Actual dependency-aware reads are captured in receipt.
Derived-of-derived is supported.
The DerivedObject payload is not a canonical persisted runtime object store; persistent build evidence is receipt/baseline/state/event data.

use_cases.name: Materialize view
use_cases.actor_intent: Сгенерировать human/machine view из object.
acceptance: Output path is resolved from managed resource metadata or explicit derived target config.
Renderer performs presentation only.
Generated output is reproducible from canonical inputs.

use_cases.name: Check dependency state
use_cases.actor_intent: Сравнить current dependency slices с validated baselines.
preconditions: receipts/baselines exist or target never validated
side_effects: persist dependency state/events; changed targets become build_required, review_required, stale or invalid according to dependency type and evidence
acceptance: Only declared/captured dependency slices are compared.
Unrelated field changes do not invalidate field-level dependencies.
Deterministic compute/copy/aggregate changes become build_required; semantic_review/compatibility changes become review_required; validity changes become stale.
Change detection does not claim semantic incorrectness and does not rebuild the target.

use_cases.name: Show project status
use_cases.actor_intent: Получить current operational state документации.
acceptance: Human output and --json represent same underlying state.
No mutation occurs.

use_cases.name: Explain target state
use_cases.actor_intent: Понять почему target stale/valid и от чего зависит.
outputs: explanation with upstream refs and last validation
acceptance: Explanation identifies exact changed dependencies and granularity.
Includes last validated baseline/receipt identifiers.

use_cases.name: Show dependency diff
use_cases.actor_intent: Показать difference между validated dependency state и current state.
preconditions: target has changed dependency or baseline
acceptance: Diff is limited to dependency slices.
Comparator semantics are explicit.
Whole-file Markdown dependency can produce diff without target JSON.

use_cases.name: Rebuild deterministic target
use_cases.actor_intent: Пересобрать computational target после invalidation.
reads: current deterministic inputs through registered builder/BuildContext
side_effects: builder executes and current dependency evidence advances
acceptance: Old raw sources are not mutated.
Successful rebuild advances receipt/baseline/state evidence for the target.
DerivedObject payload is transient and is not persisted as a canonical derived-object version store.
rebuild alone does not materialize configured views; materialize/sync owns generated file writes.
Failure leaves previous consistent state recoverable.

use_cases.name: Review semantic dependency
use_cases.actor_intent: Предоставить человеку/AI всё необходимое для смысловой проверки stale target.
acceptance: Packet contains target, old/current dependency state and diff.
Engine does not decide still-valid vs needs-update.

use_cases.name: Accept current dependency state
use_cases.actor_intent: Зафиксировать результат semantic review и новый validated baseline.
acceptance: Reason is recorded.
New baseline matches current dependencies.
State cannot be cleared by ordinary direct state-file mutation workflow.

use_cases.name: Update stale document
use_cases.actor_intent: Исправить stale Markdown/managed target и перевалидировать.
use_cases.cli_surface: Edit target with normal editor/AI tooling, then `validate`.
acceptance: Updated content is validated against current dependencies.
History preserves prior stale event/reason.

use_cases.name: Synchronize project
use_cases.actor_intent: Выполнить безопасный полный рабочий цикл после изменений.
writes: receipts/baselines for deterministic targets actually rebuilt
affected or explicitly selected generated views
acceptance: sync performs dependency checking before rebuild planning.
Only missing-receipt/build_required deterministic targets rebuild automatically.
Semantic review_required/stale targets remain attention items and are not semantically repaired.
Default sync materializes affected outputs; --all broadens materialization selection and does not force-rebuild already-valid builders.
Summary lists unresolved attention/invalid/build work.

use_cases.name: Verify project
use_cases.actor_intent: Проверить готовность проекта без исправления состояния.
reads: current project builders/rules/renderers for reproducibility checks
side_effects: no engine-managed project-state mutation; trusted project Python callbacks are not sandboxed and may have arbitrary external side effects
acceptance: Unresolved stale/review-required can fail configured release gate.
Generated drift is detected.
The engine verification operation does not repair/advance engine-managed project state.
verify may execute trusted project Python; read-only does not mean sandboxed side-effect-free arbitrary callbacks.
--json sufficient for CI/AI.

use_cases.name: Inspect history
use_cases.actor_intent: Понять chronology validation/invalidation/rebuild одного target.
acceptance: History is append-only and traceable to receipts/baselines.

use_cases.name: Promote plain document
use_cases.actor_intent: Перевести конкретный Markdown в managed structured resource постепенно.
side_effects: document ownership changes from manual to managed
use_cases.cli_surface: Future authoring helper (`promote`), deferred beyond v0.1.
acceptance: Promotion does not require promoting unrelated Markdown.
Canonical ownership after promotion is explicit.
Generated Markdown parity is established.

use_cases.name: Demote managed document
use_cases.actor_intent: Вернуть managed document к plain Markdown.
use_cases.cli_surface: Future authoring helper (`demote`), deferred beyond v0.1.
acceptance: No downstream dependency is silently broken.
Human-readable content remains available.
Audit trail records ownership change.

use_cases.name: Inspect dependency graph
use_cases.actor_intent: Посмотреть upstream/downstream graph и affected set.
acceptance: Graph distinguishes object refs from dependency edges.
Field/file granularity is visible.

use_cases.name: List resources
use_cases.actor_intent: Показать plain, managed and derived resources и materialization targets.
acceptance: Inventory distinguishes plain/managed/generated/derived.
Managed outputs are shown with documentation-root-relative paths.

use_cases.name: Clean regenerate managed views
use_cases.actor_intent: Пересоздать generated views из canonical inputs для parity/release.
acceptance: Generated views can be recreated after deletion.
No manual-only state is required to reproduce them.
Post-regeneration parity passes.

use_cases.name: Recover interrupted transaction
use_cases.actor_intent: Безопасно согласовать interrupted mutating transaction, сохранив recovery evidence и не перезаписав неизвестные post-crash изменения без явного решения оператора.
writes: restored/removed transaction targets when recovery is provably safe or force is explicit
side_effects: forced recovery records forced=true and conflict paths
acceptance: Default recovery validates the complete journal before mutation and fails closed on corrupt/rogue evidence.
Unknown post-crash changes are preserved; default recovery does not overwrite them.
--force is explicit destructive operator intent, is never used automatically, and is audit-recorded.
Successful recovery preserves an auditable recovery history and removes only resolved transaction residue.

use_cases.name: Migrate runtime layout
use_cases.actor_intent: Перевести распознанный released runtime layout в текущий layout без сброса или переписывания released dependency/materialization evidence.
preconditions: persisted runtime layout is current, empty, or a recognized migration source
side_effects: recognized legacy layout becomes explicitly versioned while released evidence bytes remain preserved
acceptance: Only registered/recognized migration paths are executed.
Released legacy evidence is integrity-checked and preserved rather than reset.
Unknown/future layouts are rejected rather than guessed.
Migration provenance is cross-checked against the migration registry and append-only audit event.
